biotools.summary: URGI (Unit Resources Genomics-Info) is a bioinformatics facility who support various research activities on plants of agronomic and forestry interest for INRAE. The platform has federated with 3 other INRAE ​​bioinformatics platforms to form the BioinfOmics research infrastructure. It is part of the French Institute of Bioinformatics which is the French node of the European infrastructure ELIXIR . URGI is part of the Saclay Plant Science network and of the Graduate School Biosphera . URGI is labeled by GIS IBiSA and is ISO-9001 certified.
